hypothesis: A broad rise in commodity prices is followed about one year later by world utilities outperforming world equities strongly and reliably enough to use as an allocation signal.

precommitted_rule.use: No material counterexample is observed in the independently checkable recent period and the claimed 12-month lag is reproducible without choosing the lag after seeing returns.
precommitted_rule.reject: A material counterexample is observed where broad commodities rise strongly and utilities materially underperform world equities about one year later, or the relationship requires ex-post lag selection.

decision: Do not use commodity-price strength with a fixed 12-month lag as a standalone timing or overweight signal for utilities. Treat it only as a narrative hypothesis until a full point-in-time long-run test with the exact claimed index definitions is reproduced.

primary_claim_source.title: グロイン｜金利急上昇時の株価調整と世界公益株式の投資機会
primary_claim_source.note: The official page identifies a segment on commodity prices and relative performance of world utilities but does not publish a machine-readable long-run regression or signal specification.

canonical_real_data.series: Global Price Index of All Commodities
MSCI World Utilities linked index return
canonical_real_data.source: State Street SPDR MSCI World Utilities UCITS ETF official performance table
canonical_real_data.note: Official linked index return shown by State Street; index methodology changed to MSCI World Utilities 35/20 Capped Index effective 2020-11-30.

observed_counterexample.interpretation: After a very strong broad-commodity rise in 2022, world utilities materially underperformed world equities in 2023 rather than outperforming one year later.

benchmark_and_alternative.benchmark: No timing signal / hold broad world equities
benchmark_and_alternative.alternative: Utilities overweight triggered mechanically 12 months after broad commodity strength
benchmark_and_alternative.result: The mechanical 12-month-lag rule fails on the 2022->2023 counterexample.

limitations: This is a falsification of the strong deterministic/timing-rule interpretation, not a full estimate of the long-run conditional expected return.
The exact Pictet chart construction, commodity index definition, lag definition and rebalancing rule are not machine-readable on the official page.

The State Street linked utilities index changed to the 35/20 capped variant after 2020-11-30; therefore this artifact must not be presented as an exact replication of a single unchanged MSCI World Utilities index back to 1998.
A weaker probabilistic relation remains UNVERIFIED until a full point-in-time monthly test over the exact source series is reproducible.
do_not_use: Do not describe the one-year commodity-to-utilities relationship as an exceptionless law.
Do not convert current commodity strength directly into a utilities overweight without a separate valuation, rates and earnings test.
Do not optimize the lag ex post and then report it as a pre-specified predictive rule.
